notes: THIS IS THE 'APPEARS NOT TO RUN' FINDING OF THIS SLICE, and it is verified three ways rather than assumed. (1) https://www.universidadviu.com/es/master-composicion-musical returns HTTP 200 only after redirecting to https://www.universidadviu.com/es/master-online-musica, which is a DIFFERENT title — "Máster Universitario en Interpretación e Investigación Musical". Aggregators (yaq.es, emagister, docenzia, topformacion, aprendemas) still list the Composición Musical master with full curriculum detail, which is exactly the trap the brief warns about — they are stale and none of them is primary. CONCLUSION for a September 2027 intake: the register says the title is alive, the university's own site says it is not on sale. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)", Nivel MECES 3, Máster RD 822/2021, verificado 10/03/2020, BOE 22/01/2021, 23/09/2021, 23/11/2024; Resolución Favorable Acreditación Institucional 12/12/2024. Evaluated regionally by ACPUA (Aragón), which is a valid evaluation route, not a weakness.
ects: 90 ECTS per RUCT (42 obligatorios + 18 optativos + 30 TFM). Note the unusually large 30-ECTS TFM — this is a research-oriented master. Unizar's estudios page does not print a total inline; the 90 figure is taken from the register and from the BOE plan de estudios.

language_of_instruction: ENGLISH. Verbatim from Unizar's own SPANISH-language official study page (so this is not an artefact of reading a translated page): "La lengua de impartición es el inglés." Corroborated by the registered bilingual title "/ Master in Robotics, Graphics and Computer Vision" and by the admission rule requiring English B2 of every applicant. This is the only English-taught programme in this slice.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 5,472.00 for the full 90 ECTS at first enrolment — 60,80 EUR/crédito x 90 = 5.472,00. (EU/resident/Spanish comparison: 30,40 EUR/crédito x 90 = 2.736,00 EUR.)
tuition_population: non-EU — this is the "Ciudadanos no UE / Non-EU citizens. Credit price 1st. Registration" figure, which is the one this Tunisian candidate pays.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — the table is headed "Enseñanzas de Máster Universitario. Precios Públicos: Curso académico 2026-2027", set by the DECRETO del Gobierno de Aragón de 24 de junio de 2026 (BOA 29 June 2026). This is a genuinely current published rate, not a carried-forward one.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — exactly double, published as a distinct row, and explicitly inescapable by studying there. The 2026-27 Unizar tariff prints two rates per cell for each master: "Españoles, residentes o ciudadanos UE 1ª matrícula" / "Ciudadanos no UE 1ª matrícula". For this master (EINA, Másteres No habilitantes) the pair is "30,40 / 60,80" for first enrolment, rising to "60,76 / 121,52" for second and subsequent. Art. 4 of the Decreto de Precios Públicos 2026-2027 applies the non-EU column subject only to international treaties and reciprocity. Decisive for this candidate, verbatim from Unizar: "La condición de residente se acreditará mediante la tarjeta de Identificación de Extranjeros (TIE) donde se indique que el tipo de permiso es por RESIDENCIA. El permiso por RESIDENCIA debe estar en vigor. El permiso por ESTANCIA o permiso por ESTUDIOS no es válido para acreditar la condición de residente, a efectos del pago de los precios de matrícula." A student visa therefore does NOT buy the resident rate here.
complementary_credits_required: RUCT (for the TITLE): NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — the Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos row is absent (null) for 4317156. Unizar admission page (for the APPLICANT): this master does not run "complementos de formación" at all; instead it gates DIRECT ACCESS on evidence of prior credits. Verbatim: "Ingeniería Informática" is listed UNMARKED, i.e. direct access with no extra evidence. Every other listed degree carries marker (1) and/or (2): "Para las titulaciones marcadas (1), (1, 2), para el acceso directo al Máster deberá además acreditarse: (1) 18 créditos ECTS cursados (o experiencia equivalente, por ejemplo el TFG) de programación de computadores, y (2) 18 créditos ECTS cursados (o experiencia equivalente) de matemáticas." A foreign software engineering degree falls formally under "Otros títulos universitarios oficiales de grado en Ingeniería o Ciencias (1, 2)", so on the published wording it must document BOTH 18 ECTS of programming AND 18 ECTS of mathematics — easily met by a 300-ECTS software engineering degree, but it must be evidenced in the CV (the page asks for languages used, credit estimates, even estimated lines of code). Additional hard requirement for everyone: "Para todos los títulos deberá acreditarse al menos nivel B2 de Inglés o equivalente, aunque se valorarán niveles superiores."
application_window_2027: NOT FOUND for 2027-28. Published Unizar máster calendar for curso 2026-27, three stages: STAGE 1 — applications 2 to 23 March 2026, provisional lists 8 April, modification 9-13 April, final lists 17 April, payment to reserve place 20-27 April 2026 (Stage 1 offers only certain masters; check the offer). STAGE 2 (all masters) — applications 11 to 26 June 2026, provisional lists 7 July, modification 8-10 July, final lists 17 July. STAGE 3 — applications 24 to 31 August 2026, provisional lists 7 September, final lists 14 September 2026. Registration periods: 22-24 July 2026 (first) and 16-17 September 2026 (second). Applicants not admitted in Stage 1 must REAPPLY in Stage 2. These are 2026-27 dates, marked as such; the 2027-28 calendar is not published and no date has been shifted forward.
notes: Best-fit record in this slice on two axes at once: English-taught and cheapest-per-year among the private options, at a public-university price even after the doubled non-EU rate. Two traps handled. (1) Unizar's estudios page shows "RUCT Code: 20260713" in some renderings — that is Unizar's INTERNAL study id (id=713 for academic year 2026), NOT the RUCT code. The real RUCT code is 4317156, confirmed by exact university+title match in the register ("por la Universidad de Zaragoza") plus the BOE plan-de-estudios resolutions. Do not write 20260713 into ruct_code. (2) The brief warns estudiospropios.unizar.es is gateway-refused; that is the TÍTULOS PROPIOS site and is irrelevant here — estudios.unizar.es and academico.unizar.es both fetch normally, and everything above was read from the primary pages, not from a search index. Access for a non-EEES degree runs through Unizar's "Access with foreign studies obtained outside the European Higher Education Area" route.
